_comment: Quest definitions. Objective types: kill (archetype), talk (npc_id), flag (quest_flags key), collect (items held), deliver (consumes on completion). 'next' auto-starts the follow-up quest. MQ001-MQ100 are the main chain (Act 2: the ash road, the Choir, and the vessel), authored by tools/gen_quests.py; they run between q1_first_light and q2_ember_omen, which keep their original content unchanged. MQ065 is the Mireille expose/protect fork.

q1_first_light.name: First Light
q1_first_light.desc: Slimes are creeping too close to the camp. Thin them out.

q2_ember_omen.name: The Ember Omen
q2_ember_omen.desc: A scorched ring burns in the northeast. Investigate it, then return to the Elder.

q3_warden_fall.name: Fall of the Warden
q3_warden_fall.desc: The Ember Warden must be destroyed. Find it at the scorched ring.

q4_new_dawn.name: A New Dawn
q4_new_dawn.desc: Return to Elder Rowan with the news.

s_cull_scouts.name: Scouts in the Barrens
s_cull_scouts.desc: Hunter Kael wants the fast ones thinned out before they raid the camp.

s_emberling_run.name: Emberling Run
s_emberling_run.desc: Emberlings keep crawling out of the ash. Kael pays per cull — again and again.

MQ001.name: Ash on the Wind
MQ001.desc: Grey flecks on the washing-line. Rowan says it is not woodsmoke, and he wants the slimes thinned before the village starts asking questions.

MQ002.name: Rendered Down
MQ002.desc: The tanner pays in coin for slime gel, and Rowan wants the stores full before the frost turns.

MQ003.name: What Wren Saw
MQ003.desc: Your sibling swears the emberlings were walking in a line -- not scattering, walking -- and asks you to break the column.

MQ004.name: Embers in a Jar
MQ004.desc: Wren wants four emberling embers sealed in a jar, to show Rowan the colour is wrong.

MQ005.name: The Road to Oakstead
MQ005.desc: Fenwick of Oakstead sent word: the mill road is no longer safe, and the village wants a sword arm to walk it.

MQ006.name: Wolves at the Fold
MQ006.desc: The wolves have stopped hunting deer and started hunting pens.

MQ007.name: Moss for the Fever
MQ007.desc: Oakstead's fever wants cave moss, and the caves are full of things that want it too.

MQ008.name: Bram's Bone Trade
MQ008.desc: Bram buys bone by the handful and sells it by the finger. He needs a consignment before the caravan leaves.

MQ009.name: The Walking Tired
MQ009.desc: Something is raising Millhaven's dead badly -- as if it had learned how from a book, not a rite. Put them down.

MQ010.name: Something Rotten
MQ010.desc: The glands in the husks are wrong for corpses this fresh. Rowan wants them on his table before the smell decides anything.

MQ011.name: Down the Mill Stair
MQ011.desc: The mill's lower floor has been open since the sluice broke. Wren will not go down; you will.

MQ012.name: Skarn's Crown
MQ012.desc: A crowned goblin has been sitting in the mill's wheel-room, holding court over a drowned village.

MQ013.name: Summons to Sunreach
MQ013.desc: A sealed writ arrives from Sunreach City. Rowan does not open it; he says the seal is on the inside.

MQ014.name: Voss's Inventory
MQ014.desc: The magistrate will talk about the ash road once the ledger balances, and the ledger needs six bolts' worth of cloth.

MQ015.name: The Warrens Under the Road
MQ015.desc: Voss admits the warrens under the ash road are not a vermin problem. He wants to know what they actually are.

MQ016.name: Burn Them Out
MQ016.desc: The warrens are breathing. Every emberling you leave is a lungful of the thing coming up the road.

MQ017.name: The Ember Tithe
MQ017.desc: Six embers, sealed and boxed, for the road wardens' braziers.

MQ018.name: Bram's Standing Order
MQ018.desc: Bram has a standing order with the tanners and no patience for suppliers who stop supplying.

MQ019.name: The Fold Rebuilt
MQ019.desc: Oakstead rebuilt the fold where the wolves came through. Fenwick wants the pack that did it thinned to nothing.

MQ020.name: The Ash Road
MQ020.desc: Rowan finally opens the writ. Sunreach is sending someone east, and the road east does not stay in the Meadows.

MQ021.name: East to Ashport
MQ021.desc: Ashport is the last town before the salt flats, and the first one the ash reached. Kael is waiting at the gate.

MQ022.name: Scouts on the Salt
MQ022.desc: The scouts are ranging further west than raiders ever did, and they are not carrying loot -- they are carrying orders.

MQ023.name: Insignia of Meat and Iron
MQ023.desc: Kael wants four insignia off four different brutes. He says two matching ones will tell him which captain is moving.

MQ024.name: Ysolde's Stock Pot
MQ024.desc: Ysolde will trade with anyone who brings iron she can actually melt, and the slag fields are full of it.

MQ025.name: The Smokestack
MQ025.desc: The old smelting works has been lit for three weeks. It has no coal.

MQ026.name: The Wraith in the Slag
MQ026.desc: Whatever has been feeding the furnace has a shape, and the shape has a grudge.

MQ027.name: Cinderhold's Captain
MQ027.desc: Cinderhold's captain wants the ash road walked by someone who is not one of her own soldiers -- and she wants a witness.

MQ028.name: Silence the Chant
MQ028.desc: The chanting starts at dusk and the walls answer it. Dael wants it stopped, not studied.

MQ029.name: Charms for the Wall
MQ029.desc: The charms Dael's smiths copy keep the mortar from singing, but the copies need originals.

MQ030.name: Scale and Sinew
MQ030.desc: Cinderhold's shields are laced with lizard hide. The lacing is wearing out.

MQ031.name: Ash Shards
MQ031.desc: Six ash shards from the glass fields, for Dael's armourer to test a theory.

MQ032.name: The Monastery Gate
MQ032.desc: Brother Ashe's order held the Scorched Monastery for eighty years. The gate is open, which is the first thing wrong with it.

MQ033.name: Brutes at the Altar
MQ033.desc: The brutes have billeted themselves in the nave. Kael finds that obscene on grounds he refuses to explain.

MQ034.name: Relics of the Order
MQ034.desc: Four relics out of the rubble, before the Choir gets a use out of them.

MQ035.name: The Chant Grows
MQ035.desc: The chant is louder than it was and it is coming from further away. Dael wants the mouth of it stopped.

MQ036.name: Warden Steel
MQ036.desc: Three ingots of warden steel, still warm, still in Choir hands. Dael wants to know how they are making it.

MQ037.name: The Salt Beds
MQ037.desc: Something in the salt beds is drilling. Kael wants the drilling stopped before it reaches the water.

MQ038.name: Glass From the Burn
MQ038.desc: Kael has a buyer for emberglass and, more tellingly, a buyer who is in a hurry.

MQ039.name: Brass by Weight
MQ039.desc: Ysolde buys raider insignia by weight -- brass is brass -- and the Choir's raiders are carrying more of it than they used to.

MQ040.name: Hide for the Stalls
MQ040.desc: Ysolde's awning is lizard hide and the season has eaten through it. She would rather buy it off a hunter than a tanner.

MQ041.name: Horns on the Road
MQ041.desc: Cinderhold's road to Ashvow is shut by something with horns and a reasonable grasp of tactics.

MQ042.name: Sigils in the Road Dust
MQ042.desc: Four Choir sigils off four different beasts. Dael says a sigil on a beast is a signature.

MQ043.name: Ashvow
MQ043.desc: Ashvow is where the ash started and where the money still is. Walk in with your hand off your sword.

MQ044.name: The Legion of Ash
MQ044.desc: The Choir has formed a legion out of people who used to be Cinderhold's. Kael asks you not to think about their faces.

MQ045.name: Grey Coats, Ash Coats
MQ045.desc: The legion has started wearing Ashvow's colours under the Choir's grey. Kael wants the grey ones put down where the city can see it.

MQ046.name: Salt, Ash and Iron
MQ046.desc: Dael's last sweep of the salt flats before she calls the road lost. She does not want company and she does not want witnesses left alive.

MQ047.name: What the Insignia Said
MQ047.desc: The insignia match. Two captains, one order, and the order came from Ashvow.

MQ048.name: Beneath Ashvow
MQ048.desc: There is a sanctum under the city, and the singing in it keeps time with the chant you have been killing.

MQ049.name: Ashvow Burns Twice
MQ049.desc: Word from the south: Ashvow's own garrison turned. Dael asks for the ones in Choir grey to be dealt with first.

MQ050.name: Scrap for the Last Forge
MQ050.desc: Eight loads of scrap for the last forge still working west of Ashvow.

MQ051.name: The Ram's Head Road
MQ051.desc: Ysolde's caravans have stopped coming. She can price a minotaur horn to the coin and would rather not have to.

MQ052.name: What Kael Kept
MQ052.desc: Kael finally says the thing he has been walking around: the Choir takes people to make vessels, and the vessels are why the ash moves.

MQ053.name: The Hollow Crypts
MQ053.desc: The crypts predate the Wardens. Wren wants to read what is on the door, and you would rather be standing next to Wren when it opens.

MQ054.name: Whatever Keeps Accounts
MQ054.desc: Something in the crypts has been keeping a ledger of the dead for four hundred years, and it has Wren's name in it.

MQ055.name: Wren's Name
MQ055.desc: The ledger has Wren's name and a date that has not happened yet. Wren laughs. You notice Wren's hands are shaking.

MQ056.name: Hollow Relics
MQ056.desc: Four hollow relics off the cold ones -- Wren says they are the same metal as the shards, and Wren is right too often lately.

MQ057.name: Skyreach Citadel
MQ057.desc: The Warden-kin hold Skyreach. They have been expecting someone carrying warm shards for a long time, and they are not happy about it.

MQ058.name: The Binding
MQ058.desc: Isolde tells you what a Warden is: a promise made into a person, and a promise can be broken.

MQ059.name: Cores of Old Ice
MQ059.desc: Three rime cores, so the Citadel's forge can burn cold enough to unmake warden steel.

MQ060.name: The Rimevault
MQ060.desc: A vault sealed with ice that was once a door. Isolde's grandmother helped seal it; Isolde wants to know why.

MQ061.name: Jorunn the Frost Giant
MQ061.desc: A giant has been standing at the vault door since the ash came north. It has not eaten, and it has not moved.

MQ062.name: Trophies of the Vault
MQ062.desc: Six hollow relics out of the vault, all of them older than the door they were sealed behind.

MQ063.name: Kilnrest
MQ063.desc: Mireille asked to meet at Kilnrest rather than at Frosthaven, and chose a night with no moon for it.

MQ064.name: The Kiln Road
MQ064.desc: Ten revenants on the Kiln road. Mireille walks it every week and has never once been attacked, which she has stopped mentioning.

MQ065.name: The Defector's Ledger
MQ065.desc: Mireille was Choir before she was anything else, and the ledger in her sleeve is the reason she left. What you do with it is up to you.

MQ066.name: Five Crystals for the Road
MQ066.desc: Five frost crystals to re-light the Kilnrest road markers, so the next caravan can find the town.

MQ067.name: Trolls at the Switchback
MQ067.desc: The switchback up to Warden's Ascent is held by trolls. Isolde's scouts counted ten before they stopped counting.

MQ068.name: Cold Iron
MQ068.desc: Five rime cores, for the one forge in the peaks that can still work them.

MQ069.name: The Old Road North
MQ069.desc: Isolde is reopening the old road to Warden's Ascent and the revenants have opinions about it.

MQ070.name: Oaths in the Snow
MQ070.desc: Skyreach's scouts have not reported in for nine days. Clear whatever is sitting on their route.

MQ071.name: The Grey Procession
MQ071.desc: Ten revenants walking in file, none of them armed, all of them in Citadel grey. Isolde wants to know what they think they are marching to.

MQ072.name: The Silent Mile
MQ072.desc: The mile of road under the Citadel is walked by revenants in Citadel grey. Isolde wants to know which of her people they were.

MQ073.name: Ward Stones
MQ073.desc: Six ward stones for the Citadel gate -- the last six, if the Choir's archons are counting the same way Isolde is.

MQ074.name: What Mireille Chose
MQ074.desc: Mireille is still standing where you left her. Whatever the ledger cost her, she is paying it now, one troll at a time.

MQ075.name: Crystal Debt
MQ075.desc: Five frost crystals are owed to a woman in Kilnrest who staked Mireille for a winter and never once asked why she left the Choir.

MQ076.name: Cold Work
MQ076.desc: Six rime cores, for the cold work of undoing a promise.

MQ077.name: Warden's Ascent
MQ077.desc: The switchback climb to the Citadel's undercroft. Isolde will not walk it; she says Wardens do not enter each other's graves.

MQ078.name: The Switchback Broken
MQ078.desc: The switchback has to be broken behind you, and the trolls are in the way of the picks.

MQ079.name: The Long Quiet
MQ079.desc: Fourteen revenants between the Citadel and the ring. Mireille calls it a procession, not a patrol.

MQ080.name: The Quietest Mile
MQ080.desc: Sixteen revenants on the last mile. Isolde will want their names, and you will want to have them.

MQ081.name: Hollow Work
MQ081.desc: Eight hollow relics, to make the door of the ring openable by something other than the thing inside it.

MQ082.name: The Citadel's Wards
MQ082.desc: Eight frost crystals to light the Citadel's gate wards one more time, for the people who will come back down this road without you.

MQ083.name: The Last Procession
MQ083.desc: Sixteen trolls on the last of the switchback, with the ring warm underneath them and the snow steaming off the stone.

MQ084.name: The Ring Wakes
MQ084.desc: Eighteen trolls walking a ring they did not draw. Mireille says the Choir pays them in something she does not want named.

MQ085.name: The Choir's Best
MQ085.desc: Archons answer to the sanctum and to nothing else. Mireille says that means someone in the sanctum is still giving orders.

MQ086.name: The Sanctum's Orders
MQ086.desc: Six archons carrying sealed orders in the sanctum's own hand. Mireille wants one of those seals intact, and wants it more than she wants sleep.

MQ087.name: Names into Light
MQ087.desc: Five more ledgers, so the names of the taken survive the people who took them.

MQ088.name: Replacing What Was Lost
MQ088.desc: Five ingots of warden steel, drawn from the Choir's own store, to reforge the Citadel's broken gate.

MQ089.name: Ledgers for the Archive
MQ089.desc: Four more of the Choir's ledgers, for the archive wing that is only opened for endings.

MQ090.name: Eight Shards, One Vessel
MQ090.desc: Eight shards of the vessel the Choir has been building since the ash started falling. Mireille will not hold them.

MQ091.name: Five Heralds Left
MQ091.desc: Five heralds left, and every one of them is carrying the Warden's seal.

MQ092.name: Archons at the Door
MQ092.desc: Ten archons standing in a ring around the scorched ground. They are not guarding it. They are waiting for it.

MQ093.name: Three Heralds
MQ093.desc: Three Ashen Heralds, all carrying the same sealed order, all addressed to you by name.

MQ094.name: Warden's Keep
MQ094.desc: The scorched ring, and under it the keep where the first promise is still being kept. Isolde's last order is one word: descend.

MQ095.name: Ash, Snow and Silence
MQ095.desc: Fourteen archons between you and the stair down. Nobody is singing now.

MQ096.name: Seals and Sigils
MQ096.desc: Six Choir sigils, unbroken, for the Citadel's archive. The archive has a wing that is only opened for endings.

MQ097.name: Heralds of the End
MQ097.desc: Six heralds, and the last one has stopped moving its lips, because the message has been delivered.

MQ098.name: The Cold That Remembers
MQ098.desc: Eight rime cores to hold open a door that was sealed warm and has hated it ever since.

MQ099.name: Ingots for the Return Road
MQ099.desc: Six ingots left at the citadel, so the road back is a road and not a walk into nothing.

MQ100.name: The Ember Omen
MQ100.desc: You climb back into the snow at the scorched ring with the ledger, the shards and the word 'vessel' in your mouth. Rowan is waiting at the edge of the burn, and he already knows what you are going to say.
